metadata.title: Rustic Country Portrait with High Contrast Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast portrait of a man in a straw cowboy hat, where the brim casts a deep shadow over the eyes. The image uses a desaturated, warm sepia-toned palette with heavy grain and a stark black background to emphasize texture and mood.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the hat brim bisects the face, creating a mystery through shadow.
The rough texture of the woven straw contrasts with the skin's fine lines and stubble.
The bright white of the shirt and hat highlights anchor the composition against a void-like black background.
coreInvariants: Eyes must remain completely obscured by shadow.
Monochromatic or near-monochromatic sepia/warm-grey color grading.
Extreme close-up framing focusing on the lower half of the face.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is off-center to the right, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The tip of the nose and the curve of the mouth serve as the primary focal points within the shadow.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the downward slope of the hat brim from top-left to center-right, then drop to the typography in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black negative space occupies the left third of the frame, providing a high-contrast base for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Creamy off-white for highlights on the hat and shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm sepia/tan mid-tones for skin and straw texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast; values range from absolute black to blown-out white highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of an extended slab-serif and a fluid, casual script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses wide, blocky proportions with heavy serifs.
Secondary text uses a handwritten, monolinear script with connected characters and long descenders.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'y' and 'g' feature elongated, looping tails that overlap the line below.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the black negative space

treatment.fill: warm white with subtle inner glow

composition.overlap: slight vertical overlap with display text
composition.relationshipToImage: bridges the gap between black space and subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, masculine slab-serif and fluid, organic script.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment to the left margin.

preserve: Extended width of the serif font

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, authoritative slab-serif feel.
Provides the casual, energetic handwritten contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, sepia-toned close-up of a man's lower face. He is wearing a straw cowboy hat with a wide brim that casts a dark shadow over his eyes. The background is solid black. The skin should show realistic texture and stubble. The lighting is harsh from the side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the lower-left corner. The top line should be a bold, extended slab-serif in uppercase. The bottom line should be a white, casual script font that slightly overlaps the line above.

verificationChecks: Is the eye area completely in shadow?
Is the color palette restricted to sepia, black, and white?
Does the typography sit in the negative space on the left?
Is there a clear contrast between the two font styles?

adjustableVariables: Specific font choices within the slab/script categories
mustRedesign: Avoid any specific artist names or album titles from the original.
Do not use the exact logo or branding marks.

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the hat and skin

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the black background.
Check that the shadow edge on the face is sharp.
Verify the straw texture of the hat is visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast sepia portrait + obscured eyes + extended slab-serif/script typographic pairing.
